ability.healing_prayer.details: Hover over a party member in the party panel or a player to heal them, or over an undead monster to damage it for the same amount. Otherwise you heal yourself. Healing someone in combat keeps you in combat. HP over the maximum is lost.
ability.battle_hymn.name: Battle Hymn
ability.battle_hymn.description: Play to speed up yourself and nearby party members.
ability.battle_hymn.details: Play the hymn for 10 seconds, taking over any tune you are playing. Moving, attacking or being hit before the end cancels it at no cost. Then you and party members within range keep the buff for 10 minutes, wherever they go. MP is spent when it finishes. Playing again renews it; hymns do not stack. The march plays on the sound effects volume, so it is heard with music off.
